zh-Hans: 还想继续跑，我不想结束。
en: I want to keep going. I don't want it to end.

zh-Hans: 发动机感觉有点怪，是我的错觉吗？
en: The engine feels a little strange. Am I imagining it?

zh-Hans: 奇怪，平常明明能跑得更好。
en: That's odd. I can usually drive better than this.

zh-Hans: 终点已经近了。
en: The finish is already close.

zh-Hans: 好开心，不想结束。
en: This is so much fun. I don't want it to end.

zh-Hans: 真想一直像这样跑下去。
en: I feel like I could keep driving like this forever.

zh-Hans: 不要，别超过去！
en: No, don't pass me!

zh-Hans: 这点小事，我才不会气馁！
en: I'm not letting a little thing like this get me down!

zh-Hans: 我是不会放弃的……
en: I'm not giving up...

zh-Hans: 为什么，是我跑得不好吗？
en: Why? Am I not driving well?

zh-Hans: 我被超过去了？
en: He passed me?

zh-Hans: 我还不想结束。
en: I don't want it to end yet.

zh-Hans: 我……要输了吗？
en: Am I... losing?

zh-Hans: 我……该怎么办呢？
en: What... should I do?

zh-Hans: 是不是该配合一下他的节奏？
en: Should I match his pace?

zh-Hans: 不行，油门踩得有点太狠了。
en: Ooh, a little too much throttle.

zh-Hans: 好奇妙，跑山时从没像现在这样充实过。
en: How strange. I've never felt this fulfilled on a mountain run before.

zh-Hans: 我只是想让他看见，现在的我能跑出的最好水平。
en: I just want him to see the best driving I'm capable of right now.

zh-Hans: 好厉害，感觉像电流一样……
en: Wow... I can feel it tingling...

zh-Hans: 背后的视线热得发烫，几乎要刺痛了。
en: I can feel his burning gaze on my back. It almost hurts.

zh-Hans: 后面的压力，越来越强了！
en: The pressure from behind keeps getting stronger!

zh-Hans: 不管对手是谁，我都绝对不想输！
en: Whoever I'm up against, I absolutely don't want to lose!

zh-Hans: 无论如何，我都想跑在前面。
en: I want to be in front, no matter what.

zh-Hans: 我只管跑好自己的。
en: I just have to drive my own way.

zh-Hans: 还差一点！
en: Just a little more!

zh-Hans: 还不能结束！
en: It can't end yet!

zh-Hans: 我的 FD，别输啊！
en: Don't lose, my FD!

zh-Hans: 再一点点……
en: A little more...

zh-Hans: 怎么会这么厉害，我这是怎么了？
en: This is incredible. What's gotten into me?

zh-Hans: 抱歉，这孩子动力太足了。
en: Sorry. This one's got a little too much power.

zh-Hans: 打起精神，好好跑！
en: Stay focused. Let's go!
